paragraphs.text: Witch's Weir is the southern branch of the huge Buzzard's Bay on the Storm Coast of western Jamuraa , on the plane of Dominaria .

Witch's Weir is the safest, although still dangerous, part of Buzzard's Bay. Here lies the keep of Fulmart's Fort and the rocky shoreline of the Goat's Walk . The weir also holds a port town also named Buzzard's Bay , which hosts the famous Seafarer's Quay and Adventurers' Guildhouse .

In 3334 AR , Emperor Johan of Tirras journeyed with an entourage to the port of Buzzard's Bay, looking for the famous library of Shauku . He found only a small local book shop, but tortured the location of Shauku's domain in Arboria from the bookseller Hebe before he killed her.
